verdict.rationale: The README offers prebuilt binaries from the GitHub releases page, Docker images, and a Winget package, plus install instructions at llama.app, so developers can avoid compiling from source. A community user confirms the official release binaries run on macOS, though only after clearing the quarantine attribute with xattr. Missing for 10: in-depth install docs in the evidence beyond one-line README mentions, broader package-manager coverage (e.g., macOS/Linux managers), and a smooth macOS binary experience without the Gatekeeper quarantine workaround.
